rationale: P. johnsonii ferments glucose and lactate as primary carbon sources with arginine providing secondary C and essential N. Nitrogen is limiting; 3.5 mmol/gDW/h uptake supports 0.35 /h growth. Fermentation products reflect mixed-acid metabolism typical of Bacteroidetes under anaerobic conditions. Carbon balance: 72 mmol in, 14.7 for growth, 57.3 for fermentation products (57.3 mmol out).
